edges.notes: UKI is consumed by UEFI firmware as a bootable PE/EFI artifact.
UKI bundles the Linux kernel image in standard UKI constructions.
ukify and UKI workflow are documented in the systemd project.
systemd-boot commonly loads UKIs on systemd-centric distributions.
Measured boot / PCR policies may use UKI with TPM2 (deployment-specific).
UKI bundles a Linux kernel that remains ELF-class internally while the outer UKI is PE/EFI-shaped.
Post-boot activation still flows through standard systemd units/targets on systemd-centric images.
Some UKI/initrd/systemd-centric boot flows deploy or consume system extensions (distro-specific).
Some UKI/initrd/systemd-centric boot flows may deploy or consume configuration extensions (distro-specific).
